claim: The reserved-memory-percent parameter defaults to 25%, and AWS says not to reduce this value, because a lower reserve can cause data loss, especially during upgrades or other changes to your cluster.

values.display: A lower reserve can cause data loss

evidence.quote: The `reserved-memory-percent` defaults to 25%. Do not reduce this value. A lower reserve can cause data loss, especially during upgrades or other changes to your cluster.
